mapper.select: SELECT ci.id, ci.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.main_image AS product_image, p.price, p.stock, ci.quantity, ci.checked, (p.stock >= ci.quantity) AS stock_enough FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC
